Carol.plan: I am the Seer. Bob (dead) was a Villager. On Day 2, I must investigate one of the living players (Alice, Dave, Eve, Frank, Grace) to find a wolf. I will prioritize investigating those who speak or act suspiciously. If I find a wolf, I will share that info publicly to guide the village vote. If I find a villager, I will remain silent about their identity to protect them, but will use the vote to potentially exile a suspect if the village identifies one, or abstain if I am uncertain.
